rules.sentence: The 2 histologic types accounting for most esophageal cancers are adenocarcinoma and SCC.
Primary esophageal lymphoma and sarcoma are extremely rare but have been reported in the literature, accounting for less than 1% of primary esophageal tumors.

Within the first few weeks, mucosal glands degenerate or become distended with secretions, and submucosal endothelial swelling and capillary dilation are seen.
Esophagitis and ulceration occur within a month.
